name: Ducks VS Demons
short: Raise a flock of rubber ducks. Watch them grow and evolve! Collect loot, buy upgrades, and defend your pond from demons in this incremental clicker.
about: Ducks VS Demons  is a short incremental clicker game about raising a flock of rubber ducks and collecting the loot they drop, all while defending your pond from waves of demons. The game features a linear Adventure Mode and an endurance-based Survival Mode.           Play At Your Own Pace    Idle:  Freely toggle the ability to  passively collect loot .   Relax:  Enable  Peaceful Mode  for a more laid-back, demon-free experience.   Automate:  Evolve your ducks to handle repopulation, feeding, and demon defense  on their own .   Simple and Satisfying Progression   Feed your ducks and they'll grow, level up, and drop more valuable loot.  Collect the loot they drop to purchase upgrades and additional ducks.  Well-fed ducks will evolve, gaining special abilities.  Defend your ducks from waves of demons to earn extra money and experience.   Features      Adventure Mode  - Play through 6 ponds to unlock additional duck evolutions.     Survival Mode  - Test your limits against an endless and increasingly difficult horde of demons.     Milestone Rewards  - Every dollar earned contributes to unlocking bonuses for future runs in Survival Mode.     Six Duck Evolutions  - Each with its own special ability.     Boss Demons  - Extra tough demons provide an additional challenge.     Duck Naming  - Give your ducks custom names, or roll a random one.
